Everything else about this beat — what it looks like, who is there, what they want and hate — is yours to paint.

angleRead.name: Rachel Torres
angleRead.text: KONO leads the incident count this cycle with 10 incidents, up from 8 last cycle. Response time averages 10.7 minutes, with a clearance rate of 22%. The property index stands at 35, and the violent index at 25. Lake Merritt, despite fewer incidents, has the slowest response time at 11 minutes. Citywide, there are 68 individuals in custody, with 34 arrests made this cycle. The public-safety roster includes 7 staff members. The focus will be on understanding the factors contributing to KONO's high incident count and the efficiency of response times across neighborhoods.
